title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: choosing the target tier on a money market upgrade request
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks to move the account up to the highest-ranked money market tier they qualify for. It fixes the order in which the money market tiers are tried and when the search stops.

## Policy clause

1. The target tier is chosen from the top of the money market ranks downward, and the first tier the account qualifies for is the target. The money market ranks, from the top, are Private Client Money Market, Premier Money Market and Money Market Account.
2. The search stops at the tier the account holds now. An account whose present tier is reached before any higher tier qualifies stays in its present tier, and no conversion is recorded.
3. An account already in Private Client Money Market stays where it is.
4. An account whose status is dormant, applied or closed when the target is chosen stays in its present tier, and no conversion is recorded.
5. The per-tier account cap of the account-holding rules and every other entry-gate item of the tier conversion rules are not part of the ranking. They are checked as eligibility of the conversion once the target is chosen. When the customer does not meet one of them for the target tier, for example because they already hold the maximum number of accounts of that tier, no conversion is recorded and no lower tier is substituted.

## The search, tier by tier

| Present tier | Tiers tried, in order | Outcome when none of them qualifies |
|---|---|---|
| Private Client Money Market | none | stays; no conversion |
| Premier Money Market | Private Client Money Market | stays in Premier Money Market; no conversion |
| Money Market Account | Private Client Money Market, then Premier Money Market | stays in Money Market Account; no conversion |
| Starter Savings, Statement Savings or Goal Builder Savings | Private Client Money Market, then Premier Money Market, then Money Market Account | stays in its present tier; no conversion |

The first tier in the "tried" column that qualifies becomes the target.

## Worked cases (hypothetical accounts)

- **No step down.** A Premier Money Market account does not qualify for Private Client Money Market but would pass the Money Market Account test. The search reaches Premier Money Market, the present tier, before Money Market Account is tried, so the account stays in Premier Money Market.
- **Skipping a rank.** A Statement Savings account qualifies for both Premier Money Market and Money Market Account but not for Private Client Money Market. Premier Money Market is tried first among those two and becomes the target.
- **Cap reached on the target.** A Money Market Account qualifies for Premier Money Market, but the customer already holds the maximum number of Premier Money Market accounts. Premier Money Market is still the target; the cap then fails, so no conversion is recorded, and the account is not moved to any other tier.
- **Account still dormant.** A dormant Statement Savings account whose figures would qualify for Premier Money Market stays in Statement Savings when the target is chosen while it is still dormant, and no conversion is recorded.
- **Nothing qualifies.** A Goal Builder Savings account qualifies for none of the three money market tiers. It keeps Goal Builder Savings, and no conversion is recorded.

## Points of judgement

**Wrong reading:** "Pick the tier whose minimum is closest to the account's money." **Correct basis:** go from the top rank downward and take the first tier that qualifies.

**Wrong reading:** "The customer already holds the maximum number of accounts of the target tier, so choose the next tier down." **Correct basis:** the cap is checked only after the target is chosen; when it is not met, no conversion is recorded and no lower tier is substituted.

**Wrong reading:** "If the present tier no longer suits the account, move it to a lower money market tier." **Correct basis:** the search never goes below the present tier; reaching it ends the search with no conversion.
